text:
emma: Heads up — after switching the coalesce jitter RNG to a deterministic seed in last night's rollout, we saw a p95 regression on alfine-13B in prod. :eyes:

sameer: Confirmed. Perf dashboards show p50 ~ same, p95 +7%, tokens/s down ~3%. Root windowing looks weird during microbursts.

perf-bot: nightly-run: model/alfine-13B : p95 +7.1%, p99 +11.2%, kv_hit_rate -12% (00:00-03:00 UTC).

marco: Logs + profiles suggest KV cache churn + kernel switching thrash when many requests coalesce at near-identical delays. Deterministic jitter collapsed arrival spread.

emma: Oy. I suspected deterministic seed would reduce variance, but it actually synchronized bursts.

daphne: Quick thought — tie jitter scale to token-budget and observed seq_len. If requests are short, we can afford smaller jitter; if long, increase jitter to avoid long-tail queuing.

marco: Agreed. Also kernel selection decisions are sensitive to microbatch size distribution. If we get spikes of identical microbatch sizes, kernel switching frequency goes up. Need to avoid synchronized windows.

sameer: Proposed config experiment A/B:
```yaml
coalesce:
  base_delay_ms: 4
  jitter_strategy: scaled_gaussian
  jitter_params:
    sigma_base_ms: 2
    scale_by: "sqrt(seq_len / model_mean_seq)"
    clamp_ms: [0, 12]
token_budget:
  target_tokens: 256
  adaptive_target: true
```

daphne: Alternatively B: uniform jitter with per-model seed salt (still randomized per-request) to keep variance but avoid deterministic syncing.

emma: We should also measure kv priming: when jitter shrinks, we see more cold-key evictions. Add metric kv_evictions/sec to canary dashboards.

marco: I'll add tracing to capture kernel_switch_count and kv_eviction_count per-slot. If kernel_switch_count spikes correlate with p95, that's our smoking gun.

sameer: Can we try short-term mitigations: 1) increase clamp_ms upper bound to 12ms, 2) add tiny randomized delta per-request (e.g., +Uniform(0,1)ms) on top of existing jitter. Low-risk rollback.

opsbot: rollout-plan requested: 1) canary 5% alfine-13B in us-west2 with experiment A, 2) monitor p95/p99, kv_hit_rate, kernel_switch_count for 2h, 3) auto-rollback on p95 > +3% or kv_hit_rate drop > 8%.

daphne: For evaluation, run synthetic microburst load with mix: 70% short (<=64 tokens), 30% long (>=512 tokens). Record microbatch size histogram and token latency percentiles.

emma: I'll own the canary. marco, can you add kernel and kv counters to the trace? sameer, can you set up the A/B experiment config templates and dashboards?

marco: on it. Adding counters and a quick flamegraph capture for the canary window.

sameer: Dashboard + alerting in progress. Will include per-model jitter distribution heatmap and per-slot coalesce delay CDF.

perf-bot: canary-start: 5% alfine-13B @ 1999991260. Monitoring started.

emma: Thanks team. If canary looks good after 2h, we'll roll to 30% and re-evaluate. If not, immediate rollback and revert jitter seed change. :thumbsup:
